title: 麻豆传媒永久关停：中国地下影视产业 20 年兴衰录  20260417【新闻大写】
executive_summary: The video discusses the permanent shutdown of 麻豆传媒 (Madou Media), a Chinese underground video platform, and reflects on the 20-year rise and fall of China's underground video industry.

key_facts: 麻豆传媒 has been permanently shut down.
The platform was part of China's underground video industry.
The industry has experienced a 20-year rise and fall.
forward_implications: The shutdown may reflect increased regulatory scrutiny of online content in China.
The incident could have implications for the future of China's digital media landscape.
